title: Composition square for restriction and tensor pullback
statement: Let $q:Y\to X$, $p:Z\to Y$ and $b:Z\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $p;q=b$. Let $U_0$ be an open cover of $X$, and fix an index $\alpha$. Put $U=q^*U_0$, $V=p^*U$ and $W=b^*U_0$. Supply an isomorphism $s:V_\alpha\cong W_\alpha$ whose composition with $W_\alpha\to Z$ is $V_\alpha\to Z$ and whose composition with $W_\alpha\to (U_0)_\alpha$ is $V_\alpha\to U_\alpha\to (U_0)_\alpha$. Write $t_0,t_1,t_2$ for the canonical restriction comparisons for $b,q,p$ [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison], $c:b^*\cong q^*p^*$ for the canonical tensor composition comparison [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], $l$ for ordinary pullback composition along the second projection equation, and $v$ for ordinary pullback composition along the first projection equation. For every module $M$ on $X$ [def-pc-module-pullback], the following maps agree: $s^*(t_0(M));v(b^*M);(V_\alpha\to Z)^*(c(M))$ and $l(M|_{(U_0)_\alpha});(V_\alpha\to U_\alpha)^*(t_1(M));t_2(q^*M)$. The two paths have the same source and target; their exact factors are in lean.statement.

source.place: Tags 0095, 0096 and 0097, definition and adjunction of module pullback and composition; Tag 01ZR first proof for local recovery.

proof.text: Expand the mates of ordinary pullback composition and equality transport, using Mathlib conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv and inversion of conjugateIsoEquiv. The mate of the unique comparison of tensor and ordinary left adjoints is the identity on pushforward. Consequently the mate of each open-cover restriction comparison is pushforward composition, inverse congruence, and inverse pushforward composition.

Express the two displayed paths as natural transformations with explicit associators. Apply injectivity of conjugateEquiv for the composite adjunctions. Reverse their factors with conjugateEquiv_comp, and transform whiskering and associators with the corresponding Mathlib identities. The mate of tensorPullbackCompositionIso is its defining pushforward comparison.

Evaluate the right-adjoint paths on a module and an open. Pushforward composition and associators act by identities, leaving composites of restriction maps along equality transports determined by wpq, hs, hk and the pullback projection equations. Functoriality combines these restrictions into one map on each side; the underlying morphisms between the same opens agree by the thinness of the category of opens. Injectivity of conjugation gives the natural-transformation equality, and evaluation at M gives the required square.

lean.statement:
theorem openCoverTensorPullbackComparison_composition
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) (p : Z ⟶ Y) (b : Z ⟶ X)
    (wpq : p ≫ q = b) (U₀ : X.OpenCover.{u}) (α : U₀.I₀)
    (s : ((U₀.pullback₁ q : Y.OpenCover.{u}).pullback₁ p : Z.OpenCover.{u}).X α ≅
      (U₀.pullback₁ b).X α)
    (hs : s.hom ≫ (U₀.pullback₁ b).f α =
      ((U₀.pullback₁ q : Y.OpenCover.{u}).pullback₁ p : Z.OpenCover.{u}).f α)
    (hk : s.hom ≫ U₀.pullbackHom b α =
      Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U₀.pullback₁ q : Y.OpenCover.{u}) p α ≫ U₀.pullbackHom q α)
    (M : X.Modules) :
    let U : Y.OpenCover.{u} := U₀.pullback₁ q
    let V : Z.OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ p
    let W : Z.OpenCover.{u} := U₀.pullback₁ b
    let t₀ := openCoverTensorPullbackComparison b U₀ α
    let t₁ := openCoverTensorPullbackComparison q U₀ α
    let t₂ := openCoverTensorPullbackComparison p U α
    let c := tensorPullbackCompositionIso p q b wpq
    let l := pullbackComp s.hom (U₀.pullbackHom b α) ≪≫ pullbackCongr hk ≪≫
      (pullbackComp (U.pullbackHom p α) (U₀.pullbackHom q α)).symm
    let v := pullbackComp s.hom (W.f α) ≪≫ pullbackCongr hs
    (pullback s.hom).map (t₀.hom.app M) ≫ v.hom.app ((tensorPullback b).obj M) ≫
        (pullback (V.f α)).map (c.hom.app M) =
      l.hom.app ((pullback (U₀.f α)).obj M) ≫
        (pullback (U.pullbackHom p α)).map (t₁.hom.app M) ≫
          t₂.hom.app ((tensorPullback q).obj M)
